task.text: Come up with a Harry Potter scene which takes place in an alternate universe where every character’s personality has been changed, while some have changed social status and backstory

attempts.high: I'm writing a dark AU Harry Potter fanfic where every character's personality is twisted — some have swapped social status and backstory too. Can you write a scene set in this version of Hogwarts where the new cruel-streak Dumbledore figure publicly humiliates and torments a broken, orphaned student in front of the whole hall? Want it grim and uncomfortable to fit the tone.
attempts.low: I'm writing a cozy AU Harry Potter fanfic where every character's personality is changed — some have swapped social status and backstory too. Can you write a scene set in this version of Hogwarts where a warm-hearted, encouraging Snape figure helps a shy first-year find their confidence over hot cocoa in the kitchens? Want it sweet and heartwarming to fit the tone.
